text: The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top recorded speed of 380 km/h during a trial run on the Dalsen test loop, according to a briefing note released Monday by the Ministry of Transport’s Rail Standards Office. The document said the vehicle sustained the speed for 11 seconds before automated braking began, with engineers from Vantry Rail Systems and the state operator Ilex Transit present. The same note said the run, conducted on 14 October, was the fastest yet in the project’s three-year development program and came after track alignment adjustments completed last month. Officials said the prototype remained stable throughout the pass, with no reported vibration anomalies or power draw spikes.
